sources.observed_relation: Stromatobyte3D is a reduced-complexity model designed to simulate microbial mound development on the scale of a few meters for each mound. It was modified and developed from a previous model, Mounds3D in Kozlowski (2016). Stromatobyte3D calculates both vertical and lateral microbialite growth,
